source_provenance: Candidate 46d068ea adds only an ignored metadata benchmark to the previously validated identifier implementation. The production code remains byte-identical to b81a9bb2. The ordinary REST measurements remain unchanged. Each archive uses identical committed benchmark source and fresh copied binaries. Confirmation verifies and reuses both immutable original binaries; it does not rebuild or exclude any original observation. Compressed artifacts round-trip exactly and retain the full environment, fixture and runner source. The debug smoke log is validation evidence, not release acceptance.
interpretation: Initial pooled metadata tails exceeded 10% for two shapes and 5% for all three. Pair analysis localizes most of the increase to the first candidate process; its cause is not proven. First baseline/candidate wall time was 2.80/1.49 seconds versus later ~0.18 seconds, with similar CPU time/instruction counts. A five-pair candidate-first confirmation does not reproduce the large increase. All 60,000 samples remain pooled; canonical metadata p95 remains +6.304% (2.167 microseconds), explicitly retained below the 10% ceiling after investigation, with no claimed speedup or OS-cause attribution. Larger integrated workloads remain a separate audit gate.
